io_contract.score_semantics: index 1 (bona-fide logit) is the score; higher = more bona fide, verified directly from the base model's own model.py SpectraAASIST3.classify() method

preprocessing.preemphasis_formula: y[0] = x[0]; y[n] = x[n] - 0.97*x[n-1] for n >= 1 (standard DSP convention; the base model's own README does not spell out the n=0 edge case explicitly)
preprocessing.short_clip_handling: tile-repeat (np.tile), not zero-pad, then truncate to exactly 64600 samples

project_measured_evaluation.dataset: SpeechAntiSpoofingBenchmarks/InTheWild (balanced 200-clip evaluation subset, disjoint from a separate 200-clip calibration subset)
project_measured_evaluation.disclaimer: These are FYP project-measured results on a small, fixed subset -- NOT the original model authors' benchmark results, and not a claim of universal real-world performance.
